column1: # Notes. (1) Sensor bus to W4 (y 45.4, 0.1 mm, 0.4 mm pitch on F): IMU_CS 21.8, SPI1_MISO 23.4, HG_CS 23.8, SPI1_SCK 24.2,
# SPI1_MOSI 24.6; on B: I2C1_SDA 22.6, I2C1_SCL 23.0, IMU_INT1 24.2. SCK and MOSI arrive adjacent and in U4's pin order
# (U4.13 SCK x 23.0, U4.14 MOSI x 23.5); MISO and HG_CS sit between IMU_CS and SCK because balls A6 / B7 lie between A4 and A7
# (ring 1 fixes the order); W4 takes MISO and HG_CS to B aft of the LI band (vias at y <= 45.0) as ROUTING_PLAN section 2
# intended. The I2C pair and INT1 (slow, not critical) cross the LI In2 band on B, so W4 needs no via for them.
# (2) Tight quadrant: fallback (b) in a no-via form. QSPI_CLK stays on F (channel y 54.8 between rows F and G, which holds
# only NC / 3V3 / VCAP balls), so the VCAP B paths cross it without any CLK via; QSPI_IO0 uses channel y 55.6 and IO3 the
# 0.7 mm gap between C19 and U3's west pads; IO1 / IO2 reach U3's east pins through vias under U3's body. C19 / C20 do not move.
# (3) The CX AUX lanes run at x 41.0 (TX) / 41.4 (RX) inside strip CX; their forward vias sit west of x 38.8 (W3 polygon),
# because a via at (40.6, 87.0) lies in W5 for F / In1 / In2 (zone_guard); the F hand-offs (35.0 / 36.0, 88.0) are kept.
